So retrosynthesis: target (stilbene) from ketone + Me3SiLi via a Wittig-type? Actually maybe a McMurry coupling? The template likely is a McMurry reaction: two carbonyls to alkene using TiCl4/Zn or using organosilicon reagents. Here we have one carbonyl (aryl-CO-aryl) and a silyl lithium to generate a carbanion that couples? Not sure.

But we just need to propose route using this template. Then we could further retrosynthesize the ketone maybe via Friedel-Crafts acylation of anisole with anisoyl chloride? But at least one reaction is required. The route must have at least 1 reaction.
